title: Custody message store (flash-backed)
description: Implement persistent custody message storage. Messages accepted via custody handshake MUST survive reboots. On boot, scan custody store and resume forwarding. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.8.1. Python: filesystem-backed store (reference impl). Rust: lichen-hal flash storage trait + lichen-core custody store. C/Zephyr: NVS or flash_map backed custody store in subsys/lichen. Storage budget per 12-apps.md §18.1.4 limits (4-64KB by platform). Eviction: expired first, then per-destination fairness, then FIFO.
